messages:
lora-sales: Heads up - NimbusHealth POC seeing repeated 429s during concurrent demo runs. Demo in 90m.
mat-support: Which endpoint and can you paste a sample 429 body?
lora-sales: They hit /v1/completions mostly. Sample (redacted):
```json
{
  "error": "rate_limit_exceeded",
  "route": "/v1/completions",
  "quota_type": "burst_per_route",
  "retry_after": 10,
  "request_id": "req-22a"
}
```
eli-eng: That's the per-route burst limiter. Trial tenants have a conservative burst (≈600/min). Their client opens ~45 concurrent short requests which spikes token accounting and trips the burst limiter. Options: temporary per-route burst bump for demo, or advise client to reduce concurrency + honor Retry-After.
mona-oncall: I can apply a 6-hour bump to 1500 for their tenant. Need sign-off from sales.
lora-sales: Approve the bump. We'll label it temporary and tell them to optimize client.
quota-bot: Quota change queued: tenant=nimbus-health, route=/v1/completions, burst=1500, duration=6h, id=Q-20260321-77
quota-bot: Change applied. Expires at 1843536200.
mat-support: Quick note on tokens: embeddings use a different route (/v1/embeddings) and separate per-route bursts, but token usage comes from a shared tenant pool. So 429s can be per-route even when monthly token usage is low.
lora-sales: Their tenant monthly usage is 7% so not token-limit related.
eli-eng: For the POC checklist to share: 1) set client max_concurrency<=10, use keep-alive; 2) implement exponential backoff + jitter using Retry-After header when present; 3) request presales quota increase if demo needs sustained high concurrency.
lora-sales: Sending guidance and noting temporary bump. Will monitor and report back before demo. Thanks team! :raised_hands:
